metrics.investment_case_interpretation: 折后可剥离净现金约 S$5.725m，高于粗筛市值 S$4.544m；同时折后可持续可分配现金利润约 S$0.643m，使 market_cap / discounted_sustainable_net_profit 约 7.1 年，按规则进入 profit_cheap。但经营业务购买价为负主要依赖现金折扣和经营现金保留假设，且审计保留意见和 2025 现金流转弱需要显著降置信度。

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group cash is disclosed only at consolidated level, mainly ordinary Singapore/HK operating subsidiaries; no parent/sub split or quick upstreaming evidence, and construction working-capital volatility requires conservatism.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash and bank balances excluding pledged deposits, potentially distributable only after preserving operating liquidity.

cash_breakdown.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - listed equities
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: All are listed equity securities with Level 1 quoted prices, but subject to market price risk and not operating cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Liquid securities can potentially be sold by a controlling owner, but not at cash-equivalent certainty.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Pledged to banks to secure banking facilities.
cash_breakdown.reason: Not detachable unless the related facility is released; excluded from cash and cash equivalents in Note 22.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing/on-demand or current borrowings are deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Secured bank loans S$0.719m plus other borrowings S$0.398m.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve about S$3.0m for labour-heavy construction/distribution operations and volatile contract-asset/prepayment funding needs.
cash_breakdown.reason: 2025 monthly revenue is about S$6.8m; contract assets and prepayments consumed cash, and the group explicitly monitors cash reserves for operations.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and distribution friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Small cross-border/dividend/friction reserve because cash is split across Singapore and Hong Kong operating entities and no parent cash split is disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Not a reported liability; conservative owner-extraction reserve.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Not mechanically deducted from detachable cash because leases relate to continuing operating assets; burden reflected in profit/cash-flow haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Leasehold land, accommodation, vehicles and office leases support ongoing business.

profit_quality.assessment: Reported 2025 profit remains positive, but cash conversion weakened materially: OCF was S$0.729m against S$1.944m profit and capex was S$0.988m, so 2025 free cash flow after capex was negative. Three-year FCF after capex median is about S$1.367m. After excluding FVTPL fair value gain, dividend income and interest income linked to detachable assets, use S$1.428m pre-haircut distributable cash profit and apply a 0.45 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Start from 2025 parent net profit S$1.944m because the latest year is available and the three-year profit median is also S$1.944m.
Deduct S$0.380m FVTPL fair value gain, S$0.030m dividend income and S$0.106m interest income to avoid double-counting returns from funds/assets treated as detachable.
Do not deduct operating lease liabilities from net cash; reflect lease and operating reinvestment burden through the profit/cash-flow haircut.
Use a 0.45 haircut because 2025 OCF/capex shows poor cash conversion, contract assets and prepayments consumed cash, and audit evidence is qualified for part of the group.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023/2024/2025 FCF after capex: S$5.766m, S$1.367m, -S$0.259m; trend is deteriorating and volatile.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Construction/distribution operations have working-capital volatility, 2025 cash conversion was weak, and the audit opinion was qualified; a low-mid 0.45 factor is used instead of treating accounting profit as distributable cash.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: weak in 2025; three-year median still positive but falling
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: maintenance capex not separately disclosed; 2025 PPE purchase S$0.988m used conservatively
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 cash absorbed by contract assets, prepayments and lower contract liabilities, partly offset by higher trade payables
